title: Codex asset generation result
description: Shape of Codex's final answer when it was asked to produce an asset file. Pass this to tools/invoke-codex.ps1 -OutputSchema so the caller gets a path to act on instead of prose to parse.

status.description: created only if the file exists on disk at 'path'.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the file that was written, or an empty string when status is failed.

width.description: Pixel width of the written image, 0 if not applicable.

height.description: Pixel height of the written image, 0 if not applicable.

hasAlpha.description: True if the image carries a real alpha channel.

notes.description: Anything the caller needs to know: what was done, what was assumed, what went wrong when status is failed. Keep it short.
